crossRefs.note: “ ‘All flying insects that walk on all fours are an abomination to you.
whose end is destruction, whose god is the belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who think about earthly things.

parallels.note: “ ‘All flying insects that walk on all fours are an abomination to you.
Yet you may eat these: of all winged creeping things that go on all fours, which have long, jointed legs for hopping on…
But all winged creeping things which have four feet are an abomination to you.

translations.web: All winged creeping things are unclean to you. They shall not be eaten.
translations.bsb: All flying insects are unclean for you; they may not be eaten.
translations.kjv: And every creeping thing that flieth is unclean unto you: they shall not be eaten.
translations.asv: And all winged creeping things are unclean unto you: they shall not be eaten.
